survival_model_test_metrics.data: SYNTHETIC held-out test patients (same split as the deployed OT-ACUTE-7 model)

lead_time.definition: days from the first alert (≥ EARLY WARNING) in the 7 days before a qualifying onset to that onset

change_point_detection.truth_definition: deterioration onset = first day the generator's latent infection ≥ 0.25 or dehydration ≥ 0.3 after ≥ 3 days below, on treatment, outside acute care
change_point_detection.match_rule: detected regime start within ±3 days of the onset and confirmed ≤ 5 days after it

bocpd.method: BOCPD — significant, adverse/mixed, not explained by a chemotherapy dose

cusum.method: per-signal one-sided CUSUM ≥ 4 on any signal (the pre-existing drift alarm)

neutrophil_twin.task: predict each on-treatment ANC result from the labs strictly before it plus the dose history
neutrophil_twin.interpretation: The twin's displayed interval describes the TRUE ANC (drug-sensitivity uncertainty only); a measured lab also carries assay noise, so lab-vs-twin comparisons use the predictive interval.

latent_state_recovery.note: Identical-twin experiment: the generator shares the observation-model structure with the twin.

event_metric_note: Arm-level event metrics use each arm's validation-derived probability threshold (PPV ≥ 25 %) without clinical rules or hysteresis so arms are comparable; the deployed-system row uses the full tiering.
